lee_sales: Quick sync — KeyTailor (prospect) asked for a POC scope + ops quote. They want BYO-HSM, dual-region key mirroring, and an offline ceremony. They expect ~10M tokens/day and want latency impact estimates + a ballpark cost. Can ENG/OPS advise what we need to run a 2-week POC?
anya_eng: +1 on scope. For BYO-HSM we need attestation artifacts (attestation cert + chain), allowed cipher suites, and network ACL details. POC options: run against their HSM via our HSM-proxy, or bring a temporary Redwood-managed HSM mirror for latency testing.
ben_ops: For the proxy approach we need: egress to their proxy endpoint (ip/cidr), mTLS certs, and a health-check port. Also want to confirm key wrap method — are they expecting AES-KW or RSA wrap? That changes CPU on the proxy.
lee_sales: They said AES-GCM for data keys + RSA wrap for master key fallback. They prefer customer-managed RSA in their HSM for key-of-keys.
zoe_security: From security review perspective, request their KMS questionnaire answers for sections 3 (key lifecycle), 5 (attestation), and 8 (rotation). Also need details on KMS partitioning — will keys be shared across tenants? If yes, we need a separate tenant mapping.
anya_eng: Technical notes: if we do BYO-HSM passthrough, expect extra RTT for wrap/unwrap calls. Rough perf delta: ~+8–25ms p99 depending on region and HSM latency. If they want 10M tokens/day and strict 50ms latency p95, we should plan for a Redwood-managed cache layer (prefix caching) to avoid per-token HSM calls.
lee_sales: Can you give a draft checklist for the presales packet I should send them? They asked for an operational plan, runbook, and a pricing ballpark they can use to budget.
anya_eng: Presales packet checklist (short):
- Required artifacts from customer: attestation certs, network CIDRs, expected QPS, key algorithm + key-size, rotation window SLAs.
- POC run modes: proxy passthrough vs managed mirror (pros/cons).
- Perf tradeoffs and recommended caching strategy.
- Test plan & acceptance criteria (latency targets, failover test, rotation dry-run).
- Security review items (audit log retention, KMS partitioning, HSM attestation).
ben_ops: For the two-week POC we need a maintenance window for the cutover test, and a staging key ceremony plan (we can script the ceremony but need an on-call for coordination). I'll own runbook drafts.
zoe_security: Also include requirements for encryption-in-transit cert rotation and how we record attestation snapshots in the audit trail.
lee_sales: finance_bot, any quick number we can give them? They asked for a monthly forecast for 10M tokens/day + BYO-HSM proxy overhead. They prefer a single-line estimate for their CFO.
finance_bot: Ballpark (very rough): hosted inference cost for 10M tokens/day: ~$8k–$12k/mo depending on model family. BYO-HSM proxy + dedicated ops for POC & attestation: one-time engagement fee ~$25k–$40k (includes on-call runbook support and ceremony scripting). If they need dedicated reserved capacity (Dedicated) to meet 99.99% SLA add ~$15k–$30k/mo. Recommend we route to sales quoting for firm numbers.
lee_sales: Helpful — please flag: they want a clause in SOW for 'attestation evidence' handoff and a 30-day rollback for keys. Any red flags?
zoe_security: Attestation evidence handoff OK, but rollback for keys is complicated: if they're BYO master keys and we store wrapped copies, we must document destruction/escrow. Legal should vet SOW language. Also add expected audit retention (we prefer 1 year by default, they can ask for 7/365 as add-on).
anya_eng: Ops question for them to confirm: will the HSM be accessible from our cloud region (us-west-2) or only via their on-prem DMZ? If on-prem only, expect added network NAT/proxy hops and schedule for network testing.
lee_sales: I'm going to send the checklist + finance numbers and ask for the artifacts. I'll cc legal for the SOW language. Any final quick asks before I reach out?
ben_ops: Ask them to run a simple echo latency test from a client in their environment to the HSM endpoint and share p50/p95/p99. Also ask for maximum parallel unwrap QPS they can support.
zoe_security: Ask them to mark any keys that are subject to regulatory retention or export-control rules. That will affect our rollout plan.
lee_sales: Great — I'll draft the email. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
system_deploy_bot: deployment-notice: created temporary POC project redwood-keytailor-POC-175500 (expires in 21 days).
